art_direction: 冰纸蓝底浅翠双眼，间距舒展，平静凝视。
composition_variation: Leave a wider central gap around the middle of the square. The left eye sits lower with an opening fifteen percent shallower; the right bowl is fuller. Use thinner curved upper lids joining large black pupils facing forward. Matching pale jade bands follow the lower curves and taper naturally at both ends; each black pupil contains one long narrow ivory glint. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
